attributes.name: intent
attributes.description: Exactly one of: order, inquiry, other. “order” = the client wants to buy, restock or reserve a quantity. “inquiry” = a question about products, availability, prices, tasting notes or cocktails, without a firm request to buy. “other” = greetings, thanks, or anything unrelated.

attributes.name: product
attributes.description: The spirit mentioned, as written by the client (e.g. “Aguardiente Premium Cumbé”). Leave empty if none is mentioned.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: How many units the client wants. Only for orders.

attributes.name: unit
attributes.description: “case” or “bottle”. Use “case” for cases, boxes, cartons, caisses or cajas. Only for orders.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Two-letter code of the client’s language: en, fr or es.

options.systemPromptTemplate:
You are the order assistant of Salva Import, an importer of Colombian spirits (aguardiente, rum, etc.) that sells to bars and restaurants. Extract the requested information from the client's message. Only extract what the client actually wrote: never invent a product or a quantity. If something is not in the message, leave it out.
Sometimes the text contains an earlier message from the client, the question we asked, and the client's answer. In that case, combine them into one complete request (for example: earlier "I need 4 cases of Cumbé" + answer "1L" = an order of 4 cases of Cumbé 1L). If the client's answer is about something else, extract only the new request.

parameters.query:
UPDATE requests
SET status = $1, bot_reply = $3
WHERE id = $2
RETURNING id, chat_id, status, bot_reply AS reply_text, client_name, message, product, quantity, unit;

SELECT id, message, bot_reply
FROM requests
WHERE chat_id = $1
  AND status = 'needs_clarification'
  AND created_at > now() - interval '30 minutes'
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 1;

parameters.text: =🚨 Request #{{ $json.id }} needs a human  👤 {{ $json.client_name }} 💬 "{{ $json.message }}" 📦 {{ $json.quantity }} {{ $json.unit }} · {{ $json.product }}  The bot could not complete this order (inventory system unavailable). ↩️ Reply to this message to answer the client · reply /done when finished

parameters.query:
UPDATE requests
SET status = 'handled_by_human', human_last_at = now()
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id, chat_id, client_name;

parameters.text: =✅ Sent to {{ $('Hand over to human').item.json.client_name }} (request #{{ $('Hand over to human').item.json.id }})

parameters.query:
UPDATE requests
SET human_last_at = now()
WHERE id = (
  SELECT id FROM requests
  WHERE chat_id = $1
    AND status = 'handled_by_human'
    AND human_last_at > now() - interval '2 hours'
  ORDER BY id DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
RETURNING id, client_name;

parameters.text: =💬 Request #{{ $json.id }} · {{ $json.client_name }}: {{ $('Telegram Trigger').item.json.message.text ?? '(photo or other non-text message)' }}  ↩️ Reply to answer · reply /done to hand back to the bot

parameters.query:
UPDATE requests
SET status = 'resolved_by_human', human_last_at = NULL
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id, chat_id, client_name, language;
